messages:
Anna (Support): FYI customer reported embeddings billing jump + dashboard showing 'vectors' and 'tokens' both increasing. They say units look triple-counted. Posting their repro and screenshots.
Anna (Support): Customer quote: "We sent 10k small texts to /v1/embeddings and our usage page shows ~30k vector units and also token units increased. Billing doubled."
Anna (Support): Screenshot link: https://redwood.s3/esc-uploads/embeds-usage-spike.png
Mike (Eng-ML): Can you paste exact API request they ran? batch size, model, any retry logic? Also need logs showing request_id if available.
Anna (Support): Repro they gave (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{ "model":"rwkv-large-embedding", "input": ["t1","t2",...,"t10"] }
```
They said they used our SDK with concurrency=8 and a client-side retry that retries on 5xx.
Anna (Support): They repro by replaying same payload 3x (their CI flakiness) — dashboard shows units ~3x but we expect idempotent aggregation.
Sara (Eng Runtime): Hmm. Possible double counting between our ingest pipeline and the metrics aggregator if the ingestion job replays messages or if cache-layer emits both token and vector-count events.
Tom (SRE): I pulled logs for the customer org_id=org_123 from 1802342000..1802350000. I see an ingestion consumer restarted at 1802347800 with offset reset -> replayed ~1200 messages. Ops deploy ~30m before spike too.
ops-bot: deploy-service/metrics-collector v2.14.1 deployed by ci-bot at 1802346000
Mike (Eng-ML): Does our metering pipeline attribute embeddings usage both on request arrival and on downstream aggregation? We had a recent change to emit per-vector metrics at both stages to improve visibility.
Sara (Eng Runtime): Yes we added a light-weight emit at the runtime entry and then a summarization in metrics-collector. If a message is replayed by the queue, and dedupe isn't enforced, that will double-count. Also check cache replay path: when KV-cache miss we send a fallback request which may also emit its own metrics.
Anna (Support): Customer reports seeing both a "vectors" line and a "tokens" line incrementing. They expect only vectors for embedding calls. They attached console CSV export.
Liz (PM): Important to know billing impact. How many billable units per embed do we treat as vectors vs tokens? Is tokens supposed to be zero for embeddings? I thought tokens is only for text-generation endpoints.
Mike (Eng-ML): Correct — tokens metric for embeddings should be 0. The tokens increments indicate our instrumentation mislabeled a metric or a legacy metric is being incremented by embeddings path. Could be a tag mismatch: metric name=embedding_tokens but actually counting vectors, or duplicate emits using different metric keys.
Tom (SRE): Quick repro steps I used:
1) send 10 requests with unique ids -> /v1/embeddings -> observe metrics count +10
2) stop consumer, rewind offset, restart -> metrics count +10 again
3) check metrics-collector logs -> shows two events per request: "emit:embeddings.vectors:1" at runtime and "agg:embeddings.vectors:1" at collector
Example log snippet:
```
2026-02-15T18:12:03Z runtime[xyz] INFO emit:embeddings.vectors org=org_123 req=request_abc
2026-02-15T18:12:04Z collector[abc] INFO agg:embeddings.vectors org=org_123 req=request_abc
```
Sara (Eng Runtime): Can you attach the customer's request_id values? If client retries set new request_ids we can't dedupe. We should use an idempotency key from the payload (customer-provided) or compute a deterministic hash of input to dedupe in collector.
Anna (Support): Customer says their SDK didn't set an idempotency key. They relied on default client retry which sends new request_id per attempt.
Mike (Eng-ML): Ok. Root causes likely threefold: 1) runtime emits metrics on initial request, 2) collector also emits/records per-message summary, 3) no global dedupe when consumer replay or client retries with new ids. Also metric naming bug may cause tokens to be incremented for embeddings in one of the emitters.
Tom (SRE): Short-term mitigation: mark the ingestion consumer to ignore duplicate payloads within X minutes using a hash cache. I'll add a sticky session to avoid rewinds during audits.
Sara (Eng Runtime): I'll push a small change to stop emitting the per-request 'embed_tokens' metric from runtime; let collector be the source-of-truth. Also add a tag to clearly mark metric.type=vector to avoid token mislabeling.
Mike (Eng-ML): I'll add a dedupe layer in metrics-collector: compute sha256(payload) and ignore repeats seen in last 10m. Also run a backfill job to dedupe yesterday's window for billing reconciliation.
Anna (Support): Customer impacted: invoice #INV-558 shows 2.9x expected. They opened a billing dispute. Can we provide credit while we fix? They say it's urgent.
Liz (PM): Approve 80% provisional credit pending root cause. Finance notified.
ops-bot: PR #4876 merged by Sara at 1802349200 -> runtime: stop-per-request-emit
ops-bot: PR #4879 merged by Mike at 1802349800 -> collector: dedupe-hash-cache
Tom (SRE): Hotfix deployed 1802350000. Monitoring: embeddings units back to baseline in last 10m. Patch also added metric tag fix for tokens->vectors.
Anna (Support): Customer notified, finance issued provisional credit, customer acknowledged and will monitor. Closing escalation unless we see recurrence.
Mike (Eng-ML): Follow-up: we'll run a billing re-run job and send detailed usage delta to finance + the customer by EOD.
Liz (PM): Thanks team. Reminder: add an internal runbook for "metrics replay" events and clear guidance on idempotency for SDKs.
Anna (Support): Closing thread. :thumbsup:
